comments:
His dates can be approximated as 1070-1130.

He is possibly the same person as Byang 'chad khyung (ID:6382), as [NA9AMDH6] states that Khyung rin chen grags held Byang 'chad (ID:4416) and taught Sa chen (ID:4205) there ([647FFPZR]: 543). [CJ75QQKN]: 339 (fol. 8a/170a1-3).
dMar ston's Zhib mo rdo rje ([RA3FK3BK]: 134 and 137), on the other hand, distinguish the two figures and places Sa chen's studies with Khyung at Nyang stod byang 'chad, and those with Khyung rin chen grags at Nyang stod.

On the reference to Khyung as "slang pa/slang pha/slang pha ba" (understood as a regionalism for "glang pa/glang pha ba," see [WL39GVT5]: 940.
